retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic layout featuring a large beveled Roman numeral mask that reveals two contrasting character portraits against a soft-focus background.
excludeWhen: single subject without masking is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, large-scale metallic Roman numeral 'W' acts as a window, framing two distinct faces—one green-toned and forward-facing, the other fair-toned in profile—set against a blurred, atmospheric background of the same characters.
coreVisualRelationships: Central beveled mask framing internal portraits
Complementary green and pink color split across the vertical axis
Sharp foreground typography against soft-focus background silhouettes
Metallic gold textures unifying disparate character elements
coreInvariants: Large central beveled Roman numeral mask
Stacked hierarchical typography at the bottom center

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two primary faces are centered within a large 'W' mask that occupies 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, beveled metallic 'W' mask in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central masked faces, move down to the primary title, and then to the secondary credits at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Soft-focus background silhouettes provide depth without cluttering the central focal point.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep emerald green for the left-side character and lighting.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Soft magenta and sunset orange for the right-side character and sky.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Polished gold for the beveled edges of the mask and typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central masked area with lower value, atmospheric tones in the background.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses heavy, beveled 3D serifs with sharp spurs
Secondary text uses a clean, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif
Metallic gold outlines with internal color gradients
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'W' is elongated and serves as a framing device
The 'K' features a sharp, elongated leg
The 'D' has a deep, beveled inner counter

composition.relationshipToImage: anchors the bottom of the mask

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of heavy, decorative 3D display type with thin, widely spaced geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic cinematic serif skeleton for the primary title
Clean geometric sans for the wide-tracked credits

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dual-portrait background with a green-skinned character on the left and a fair-skinned character with a crown on the right, both in soft focus. Overlay a large, beveled gold 'W' shape in the center that acts as a window to reveal sharp versions of the same faces.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in a beveled 3D serif font at the bottom of the 'W' mask. Place secondary credits in a wide-tracked gold sans-serif at the very bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the 'W' mask beveled and metallic?
Are the two faces clearly separated by color (green vs pink/natural)?
Is the secondary text widely tracked?
Does the primary title have a 3D depth effect?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the mask correctly frames the eyes of the subjects.
Verify the gold bevel has consistent lighting direction.
Check that the wide-tracked text is legible against the background.
Confirm the green and pink color balance is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central Mask + Dual Character Contrast + Beveled 3D Type + Wide-Tracked Credits
